meta.notes: Cầu thang từ Garden of Hush (map 5): 9 bậc 0.18 m xuống, vòm gothic, tường đá hầm (tile BIO27_vault) + 1 mô-đun tường hầm GLB ở đầu cầu thang. Lối vào: lối 8 m giữa hai dãy cũi xương khổng lồ (A14.1, cao 2H) giống hệt nhau, chạy tiếp vào sương đen cả hai đầu (giả vô hạn), thảm lanh dẫn vào, đèn ngủ trắng sữa đứng yên. Arena ⌀ 32 m: vòng cũi + màn lanh, 10 đèn ngủ (thanh Đèn ngủ còn lại), giường chăn chần dọn sẵn, chuông xương treo, nôi của Mercy trên đế bập bênh, Hospice Mother (B05, blockout đúng cỡ: cao 2.75H, tay 3H). Mọi model là blockout (màu theo nhóm); quái trong Play là mô hình thay thế đặt theo id ASHLAR.

coordinateSystem.system: three.js right-handed, Y up, metres. x = east, z = south (the default game camera looks north), y = height above the ground datum (water level 0 unless the map says otherwise).
coordinateSystem.yaw: yawDeg = rotation about +Y in degrees, three.js Object3D.rotation.y (positive turns +z toward +x: a piece whose front is local +z faces (sin yaw, cos yaw): 0 = south, 90 = east, 180 = north, -90 = west).

terrain.note: interior floor: floorY(x, z) of the rooms (levels, sloping floors, stairs, ramps); NaN = no floor (outside the rooms / under the walls)

heightfield.sample: cell centre: x = x0 + (i + 0.5) * cell, z = z0 + (j + 0.5) * cell

wallShade.note: grey vertex colour of every wall vertex (multiply the base colour; vertexColors = true): c = lerp(1, topDark, smoothstep(h, top, top + fade)) * (0.82 + 0.18 * smoothstep(h, 0, 0.5)), h = vertex y minus the floor height under it (floorY(x, z), metres); `top` = the wall style top (style.top, default style.height * 0.62). The wall fades to black above its top (no ceiling: the room dissolves into darkness) and is slightly darker at the foot

floorShade.note: grey vertex colour of floor mesh corners (x, z) with dv = wallDistance(x, z) (metres; > 0 inside a room, < 0 outside / under a wall): walkable floor c = 0.86 + 0.14 * smoothstep(dv, -0.2, 1.2) (slightly darker at the walls); apron (floor cells past a void edge, not walkable, up to `apron` m) c = 0.86 * (1 - smoothstep(-dv, 0, apron * 0.8)) (fades to black)

rooms.name: Cầu thang từ Garden of Hush

A14.1.name: Bone-rail crib frame
A14.1.note: arena-scale empty crib (giant: 2H tall); rows into the fog are the same model; the GLB is a closed rail box (bars ≈ 0.4 m apart, mattress floor 0.83 m) 4.27 m deep (concept 3.6 m): the aisle rows stand 0.53 m apart, the arena ring reaches 0.29 m inside the arena edge; Mercy's cradle is the same GLB at 0.8 on its rockers; a box collider (the crib blocks as a whole: its 14 k triangles × 22 stay out of Play's collision)

A14.2.name: Linen curtain pair
A14.2.note: wooden posts + rod (block), tied-back linen drapes (walk-through cloth); the GLB posts at (−1.84, −0.17) and (1.79, −0.17): 2.95 m between them, 3.28 m clear under the drapes; a collider on the posts only (the model's drapes stay out of Play's collision)

A14.3.name: Milk-white night-light
A14.3.note: still Perfection light; the arena ten go out one by one (slider); the light, its halo and the glowing globe (KIT globe, additive over the GLB's milk glass, Ø 0.72 m round (0, 1.77, 0)) on the model; a collider prism keeps its triangles (×64) out of Play's collision

A14.4.name: Bone mobile on stand
A14.4.note: only the stand blocks; the hanging bones are walk-through (they hang to ≈ 0.9 m at x +0.3…+0.8: a collider on the stand only keeps the model out of Play's collision)

A14.5.name: Quilted floor platform
A14.5.note: the bed made up for the hero (too high to step on: the GLB mattress top 0.83 m, its cushions 1.32 m; concept 0.72 m); 4.8 × 5.4 m, blocks as a whole (a box collider)

A14.6.name: Rocker runner pair
A14.6.note: one under Mercy's cradle behind the boss (at 1.15: its curled ends rise past the cradle's ends, the cradle's floor on its bars, 1.07 m), two lying loose; the GLB runners are 1.76 m tall at the curled ends

N-CR03.note: square: 1.5 × 1.3 m (concept 1.5 × 0.75 m), 0.54 m thick, three thin red lines near +x (QA: the brief has one band); at the head of the platform, clear of the quilt; laid ON_CUSHIONS
